_source: Built from Zoho_To_CHEDS_ (35).ds workflow Push_Api_Production39 + HEDB Data Dictionary 202601 sheet 'Institute - Publications'.
_note: raw_column values are the HEDB 202601 'Database Field Name' headers. Picklist value_maps come from the literal code/name tables inside the app's thisapp.Dropdown_Fields functions, so the imported text matches the Zoho choice exactly and the push converts it back to the Ministry code.

fields._note: Reference only -- the Zoho form derives the institution name from the institution code lookup, so no column is written.
HEDB code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist choice text; the push converts it back with thisapp.Dropdown_Fields.Researcher_Type() (workflow Push_Api_Production39).

value_map.CP: PI with Co-Authors from within institution
value_map.CO: PI with Co-Authors from outside of the institution
value_map.IH: Co-Authored from within the institution and this faculty member is not the PI
value_map.OS: Co-Authored with faculty from another institution and the reporting faculty is not the PI

fields._note: HEDB code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist choice text; the push converts it back with thisapp.Dropdown_Fields.type_of_Publication() (workflow Push_Api_Production39).

value_map.CW: Creative Work (Art specialization: Design, Architecture , Painting, etc.)

fields._note: Picklist choices = ['Yes', 'No']; workflow does .subString(0,1) for the API. Using 'yesno' for flexible Y/N/true/false/1/0 raw input.

value_map.A: A- Arabic publications not listed on SCOPUS
value_map.B: B- Validated local campus affiliation that does not appear in SCOPUS

fields._note: Picklist choices = ['A- Arabic publications not listed on SCOPUS', 'B- Validated local campus affiliation that does not appear in SCOPUS', 'C- Creative output']; workflow does .subString(0,1) to get a 1-char code for the API. value_map assumes raw data holds that short code -- if raw already has the full literal text, switch this field to kind:'plain' instead.
Reference only -- CHEDS says to send Last Updated ONLY through the master API; the push stamps it with zoho.currenttime on success.
